resources.string: Advanced typesetting for standard-text EPUB rendering. The first page of each chapter and the remaining pages can be laid out separately; complex templates may be slow on first use, so preview before applying. Automatically falls back to the original layout if something goes wrong.
Use the layout, header, and footer from reading settings
Import page templates or a standalone backup

\"Export file\" shares a single template; \"Standalone backup\" saves the template library and the hidden state of built-in templates, and both can be imported from a file. The template library is not included in regular backups. Imports are merged, and different content under the same ID is saved as a copy.

Apply templates in EPUB rendering mode for standard text.
HTML, CSS, and JavaScript are saved as written, with no filtering of tags or styles. Saving only checks the template format; runtime errors show up in the preview or the text.

JavaScript global object: readerTemplate.
source: the editable text DOM; fields: dynamic information; viewport: viewport information.
Use readerTemplate.on(event, handler) to listen for beforeLayout, beforePage, afterPage, afterLayout, pageChange, fieldsChange, motionChange, and dispose; the return value cancels the listener.
Modify the text in beforeLayout and set the text area in beforePage. afterLayout provides the candidate pages for this pass; pageChange reports navigation; motionChange reports the committed current page and the actual state, and also fires on first display and re-pagination.
Bounded async preparation: readerTemplate.waitUntil(promise); request re-pagination: readerTemplate.requestLayout(). Do not wait for endless animations or reflow unconditionally inside pagination hooks.
motionChange state is settled, running, or paused, and does not wait for the returned Promise. Start and pause JS animations based on it, keep the full static frame when settled; release old work on page change, and clean up timers, events, and requests in dispose. The Starry Moon template starts its JS with a complete example; HTML, CSS, and JS can all be rewritten freely.

Text area: data-reader-flow="body"; you can place several, and they flow in DOM order or by data-reader-order.
Dynamic information: data-reader-field="chapterTitle|bookName|time|battery|page|pageIndex|pageCount|progress"; each element picks one field.
Page root: data-reader-page="first|other". Text paragraphs and chapter titles: .reader-paragraph, .reader-chapter-title.
Style variables: --reader-text-color, --reader-page-background, --reader-accent, --reader-font-size, --reader-line-height, --reader-paragraph-indent, --reader-paragraph-spacing.
